# Vendored browser dependency

`model-viewer.min.js` is the unchanged Google `<model-viewer>` 4.3.1 distribution. It is served
locally so model previews and the shared before/after scene do not depend on a public CDN at run
time. The upstream Apache 2.0 license is preserved in `model-viewer.LICENSE`.

Upstream: <https://github.com/google/model-viewer/tree/v4.3.1>
